comment: The window's themes (US-151). Each is 1 entry here and, when it has colors of its own, 1 :root[data-theme='<id>'] block in src/renderer/tokens.css (the single source of color). scene names a painting in src/renderer/settings/scenes/ drawn behind the cards; motion is what moves in it. unlock: null for everyone, {rank} for a belt, {pro: true} for murmur Pro. The id ember is night studio, kept from before themes had names; it is also the id of the ember red accent in cosmetics.json, a different item.
